verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an Editor API for automating and programmatically driving the Editor, including asset management, plus a SplatTransform CLI that batch-converts and processes Gaussian splat data, so scripted asset handling exists. Nothing in the evidence shows import hooks, import presets, or rules that process incoming assets automatically on arrival. missing for 10: import hooks/callbacks on asset ingest, import presets/settings templates, documented end-to-end import pipeline scripting for general assets (models/textures), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical artist, asset import is automatable — import hooks, presets, and pipeline scripts process incoming assets without hand-clicking each one

citations.quote: The Editor module provides a comprehensive API for automating and extending the functionality of the PlayCanvas Editor. It allows developers to programmatically interact with the Editor, facilitating tasks such as scene manipulation, asset management, and custom tool integration.
SplatTransform (`@playcanvas/splat-transform`) is a CLI and library for 3D Gaussian splats: it converts between formats, transforms, filters and merges splat data
